name: Victory aftermath
description: One results screen after a won battle (EXP bars that fill per actor, gold and items found), then a level-up screen per actor with the stat changes, newly learned skills and a quote.

actors.label: Level-up quotes (Victory aftermath, one per line)
actors.help: One is picked at random for this actor's level-up screen. Text codes such as \N[hero] work.

actors.label: New skill quotes (Victory aftermath, one per line)
actors.help: Used instead of a level-up quote when the actor learned a skill. Empty: the level-up quotes.

settings_schema.label: Seconds the EXP bars take to fill
